mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a deceleration in payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.1pp and PAYEMS growth rate (MoM) decreases by more than 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when HOUST declines by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A reading of industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5 percentage points in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when GDPC1 growth (quarterly) is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% indicates strong consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5%.
